findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screenshot_webpage, webpage_to_markdown, ocr_read_text, website_status_check · Private data: screenshot_webpage, webpage_to_markdown, convert_file, html_to_pdf, transcribe_audio, website_status_check · Public sink: pdf_tables_to_json, ocr_read_text, convert_file, html_to_pdf, transcribe_audio · Destructive: convert_file, html_to_pdf, uk_postcode_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screenshot_webpage, webpage_to_markdown, ocr_read_text, website_status_check · Private data: screenshot_webpage, webpage_to_markdown, convert_file, html_to_pdf, transcribe_audio, website_status_check · Public sink: pdf_tables_to_json, ocr_read_text, convert_file, html_to_pdf, transcribe_audio · Destructive: convert_file, html_to_pdf, uk_postcode_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
